Behind her, a stainless steel refrigerator and light-colored kitchen cabinetry are visible. (2) She holds up a blue rectangular container of yogurt to the camera, emphasizing the product. Her hands are manicured with dark polish, and she maintains eye contact while explaining. The lighting is even and studio-like, highlighting her facial features and the product details. (3) The scene shifts to a low-angle close-up of a white bowl containing four peeled, hard-boiled eggs. The character uses a metal spoon to tap the side of the bowl. The background shows a clean countertop and a kitchen sink area. (4) She demonstrates opening a silver tuna can with a pull-tab. The camera captures her hand movements and the texture of the metallic lid as she peels it back. She then tilts the can to drain liquid into the yogurt container. (5) A montage follows where she uses two large spoons to vigorously mash and mix the eggs, tuna, and yogurt together in the white bowl. Her movements are rapid and rhythmic. Yellow and white text overlays flash on screen for emphasis during this process. (6) The character takes a slice of thick, golden-brown toast and spreads the prepared salad mixture onto it. She takes a large bite, displaying a joyful and satisfied facial expression, closing her eyes as she chews. She then holds up a plastic container with yellow contents to compare it with her fresh mixture.
